description: This file implements the 'Web Resource Locator' object management functions, specifically the 'Engage' and 'Cancel' methods, which activate and deactivate the resource locator respectively. It is part of a larger web server/client/application system, managing the lifecycle of resource locator objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRloEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Activates the Web Resource Locator object by setting its 'bActive' flag to TRUE. If already active, it simply returns success without changes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WebRloCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deactivates the Web Resource Locator object by setting its 'bActive' flag to FALSE. If already inactive, it simply returns success without changes.
